content:
I have this branch to add Physlib.Electromagnetism.Kinematics.GaugeTransformation. I also asked Fable 5 to interrogate GaugeTransformation and it came up with a further two commits.

Is this useful/helpful? Should I create an issue first? Or would you rather I work in some other area? Thanks for setting up this project.
Hey Justin! Would you mind making a pull-request with the suggested changes (it just makes it easier to distill the new content).
But in short - this looks like it would make a very nice PR.

ok, the final form of the branch weighed in at more lines than I wanted. I'm trying to balance pedantic/clinical with the broadly universal heuristic. Let me know if there's too much specificity or if it's overwrought.
This looks great to me! I added a comment about ordering to the PR
